system.description:
Casting takes 1 hour. Name one person, place or object: you learn 3 true facts about its history, powers or current region; if you hold the object or stand in the place, you learn 5. Nothing is learned if the subject has no recorded history. Material: incense worth 250 gp and four ivory strips worth 50 gp each, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Warlock, Bard, Necromancer, Witch
